bootstrap_FULL_vs_NATIVE.estimand: 3-seed mean of the pooled metric, identical to the bar

diagnostics.lambda_selection: NOT APPLICABLE AT A0 -- the A0 oracle has no lambda_orbit. lambda_orbit first exists at Stage-1, where it is selected inside outer-train folds only.

shuffle_control.H0_behaviour: FULL and SHUFFLE are exchangeable under the EXCHANGEABILITY null (displacements i.i.d. across items and independent of the item). They are NOT exchangeable under every uninformative-orbit null -- a purely radial displacement leaves FULL identical to NATIVE while SHUFFLE still perturbs. FULL > SHUFFLE is therefore NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT, and it cannot manufacture a PASS: under that radial null FULL == NATIVE so delta_acc = 0 and the binding +0.050 bar is unreachable.
shuffle_control.grouping: partition (fitting pool vs held-out fifth) x degeneracy class; the partition boundary is never crossed. A class group of exactly one member is DROPPED, so that item keeps its OWN displacement in SHUFFLE. For the case that matters -- a lone DEGENERATE item, whose displacement is ZERO by construction -- SHUFFLE is then EXACTLY MATCHED to FULL for that item and it contributes to neither side of the conjunct; merging would instead have handed it a real displacement and made FULL > SHUFFLE EASIER. A zero-guard (video-decode-failure) row counts as degenerate, because its orbit is the identity in every space.

PARITY_NAT.predictions_and_sorted_similarities: BIT-EQUAL on every checked cell; a mismatch HALTs and the cell count is asserted equal to seeds x folds, so this line is reachable only when all 15 cells passed
PARITY_NAT.rule: orbit oracle on the {NAT} orbit must reproduce mechfix_ops.deployed_vote

criterion_4_same_baseline_consumed_the_r.evidence: the banked native cache used by the paired floor carries the same zero rows, which criterion 2 verifies numerically

ZERO_CONTRACT.treatment: retained in bank and queries, identically in every arm; a sensitivity read excluding them is reported separately

secondary_raw_arena.note: raw fused key space l2n(concat(l2n(img), l2n(text_view))). SECONDARY under F113: may corroborate a KILL, may never promote a lead.
